title: fix: hide announcements for signed-out users
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Hides Announcements when the user is signed out, using the existing dashboard user state.
- Removes the Announcements heading from the loading placeholder.

Validation: frontend build and Biome pass. TypeScript reports the same five pre-existing backend errors on unchanged main.

gist.headline: Notices for the right bees
gist.blurb: The announcements board waits until someone signs in. Its heading also stays out of the loading placeholder, where it had nothing to announce.
gist.summary: The Enter dashboard uses its existing user state to hide Announcements for signed-out visitors and removes the Announcements heading from the loading placeholder.
gist.impact: Signed-out visitors get a cleaner dashboard, while signed-in users retain their announcements.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Enter's announcements as a small garden noticeboard that Polli opens for a signed-in visitor; an empty loading frame nearby has no heading. Keep the scene friendly and quiet, with a prominent lime-green garden and a tiny clipboard accessory for Polli.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel garden, Polli opens a little announcements noticeboard beside a glowing sign-in doorway, while a nearby empty loading frame has no heading. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny clipboard, stays small-to-medium in the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; chunky sprites, prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream and mint, and dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
